summary: Tested BdCompat Installer backend (5 pytest tests) and frontend wizard flow end-to-end. All backend endpoints (/api/info, /api/plugin/preview, /api/installer/download) return correct data. ZIP contents validated for autoquest=true/false and beta targets. Frontend wizard slides (welcome->plugin->settings->install->done), back navigation, toggles, download trigger, re-download and restart all work.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: canary flag also toggles DiscordDevelopment which conflates two Discord builds; may want a separate flag if that matters
download_installer streams full response body from a BytesIO buffer built synchronously; fine for small ZIPs but should stream from disk if payload grows
@app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; prefer lifespan handlers
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_installer_api.py and validate ZIP structure via zipfile. Frontend flow: welcome -> plugin (choice-plugin-yes/no) -> settings -> install (~4-5s) -> done. Download is triggered automatically on reaching 'done' slide via hidden anchor.
